title: Code-first content type libraries
description: Document types defined in C# attributes by a library and synchronized at startup.

impact.summary: The types live in the database; the library needs a release for the target or is no longer needed.

handling.option: Confirm the types exist in the database, then remove the library with an approval
handling.when: The types are in the database

checks.text: All content types defined in code exist in the migrated local copy
